verdict.rationale: GitHub's own page states that individual subscribers can opt out of having their data used for AI model training at any time, which directly delivers the story. The only community item on the topic (comm-18) is general skepticism about enterprise guarantees rather than concrete contradicting evidence, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how to opt out and which data it covers, explicit coverage of Business/Enterprise plans, independent or hands-on corroboration that the opt-out is honored.
